name: qjs_to_cstring_len2
prototype: const char *qjs_to_cstring_len2(void *ctx, size_t *length, uint64_t value, int cesu8)

ownership.argument: Retains/constructs a QuickJS string backing the returned C string. Reports UTF8 byte length, accepts CESU8 flag, caller must use qjs_free_cstring0xC278848. Does not return a naked malloc allocation.

provenance.source: Exact 3.101.036 AP producer/consumer and data-layout review; see p67-036-native-contract.md.

notes: Corrects false composition finding claiming engine has no direct accessor. FreeCString must release original QuickJS string header, so manual len+1 malloc copying is not ABI-compatible.
